The desire is to enhance the OR-SAGE tool to allow customers to make informed decisions regarding data center siting or data center siting supported by a collocated NPP. 5 selected advanced non-light-water reactor siting factors for a nominal small NPP provide a high level of discrimination and readily available data. The default small, advanced NPP siting criteria can be found in Appendix A of reference 4. A similar approach is envisioned for the development of data center siting parameters. However, data center siting is not as highly regulated as NPP siting and operation. So, a more flexible set of parameters to consider for data center siting is envisioned because of this effort. 6 2.
